hyperedges.label: Foundation to semantic role to component usage

nodes.label: Resolved theme JSON export
nodes.rationale: Exports group resolved CSS-variable values for the selected theme; the format does not claim DTCG interchange compatibility.

nodes.label: Turborepo cache policy
nodes.rationale: Development servers remain persistent and uncached; production artifacts exclude Next.js internal cache and development outputs; the formatter runs directly because it changes files.

nodes.label: Stable theme hydration
nodes.rationale: Stable server snapshots, expected root attribute-warning suppression, and pre-paint saved-preference initialization keep theme controls consistent through hydration.

nodes.label: Modern Admin Dashboard reference
nodes.rationale: The reference hierarchy informed an original implementation with interactions, responsive behavior, explicit illustrative data, and an explorer; direct browser inspection failed, so pixel-level equivalence is not claimed.

nodes.label: Design system app configuration
nodes.rationale: Shared UI supplies components, charts, tokens, styles, and runtime dependencies; the app owns TypeScript, ESLint, PostCSS, fonts, providers, and shadcn CLI aliases.

nodes.label: TypeScript source package exports
nodes.rationale: The package exports TypeScript source; Next.js consumers can transpile it through transpilePackages, which the dashboard already configures.

nodes.label: Development validator exclusion
nodes.rationale: Excluding the development validator avoids unused API-route imports generated for an app without API routes. The production validator remains included, preserving strict checks.

nodes.label: useSyncExternalStore subscriptions
nodes.rationale: The generated carousel and mobile hook use external-store subscriptions to comply with React lint rules.

nodes.label: jiti configuration loader
nodes.rationale: Consumers load explicitly typed Linter.Config[] TypeScript modules from eslint.config.ts using jiti, without a compilation step.

nodes.label: Babel TypeScript 7 parsing
nodes.rationale: Babel parses TypeScript 7 for ESLint while native TypeScript handles symbol checks, avoiding the older JavaScript compiler API required by typescript-eslint.

nodes.label: Typed component example registry
nodes.rationale: apps/design-system/components/design-system/component-examples/registry.ts requires an example group per installed component. Previews are immediately visible, expose 288 selectable states and variants, and load in separate groups.

nodes.label: Design token name catalog
nodes.rationale: lib/design-tokens.ts stores names and descriptions without duplicating visual values; the explorer resolves active CSS variables.

nodes.label: Semantic cn class merger
nodes.rationale: Typography size utilities replace size classes without removing semantic text colors.

nodes.label: Three-level design token architecture
nodes.rationale: Foundations feed semantic roles, which feed component usage. Raw colors remain in the token source and theme overrides replace values without changing markup.

nodes.label: Typography primitive
nodes.rationale: Pure server/client-compatible text composition centralizes type scale, semantic colors, and native semantic elements without adding a client boundary.

nodes.label: Atomic component layer
nodes.rationale: Installed shadcn primitives and Typography live in atomic so primitives share text styles without depending on molecules; the shadcn CLI ui alias points here.

nodes.label: Chart rendering error boundary
nodes.rationale: Rendering failures retain the data table; new data resets the fallback boundary.

nodes.label: Caller-owned chart interaction state
nodes.rationale: Selected series and filtered data remain in the parent; reusable charts receive series or data and expose Recharts handlers through chartProps.

nodes.label: Dashboard application state boundary
nodes.rationale: App-specific data stays in dashboard components; routes remain server components and interactive behavior is isolated in client modules. Backend integration replaces data.ts with server-fed props or an application data layer.

nodes.label: Panel composition
nodes.rationale: Panel, PanelHeader, PanelContent, and PanelFooter consolidate repeated card headers, padding, and footer structure; composition stays server-compatible and has no application state or fetching.

nodes.label: Chart direction geometry
nodes.rationale: RTL mirrors Cartesian axes and polar angles while retaining data order, scale, and text coordinates; isolated LTR numeric runs preserve signs and units in RTL text.

nodes.label: Logical layout direction
nodes.rationale: LTR and RTL use logical layout, spacing, navigation, and side placement while English content remains unchanged. Intentional physical side overrides remain supported.

nodes.label: Next.js agent-file generator
nodes.rationale: next dev re-adds the generated rules; committing the block avoids recurrent uncommitted changes.

nodes.label: Installed Next.js documentation
nodes.rationale: The installed version has breaking API, convention, and file-structure changes; consult its bundled guides before writing code.
